description: A glass-fronted annex grafted onto the flank of the KSAB tower, its holo-marquee stuttering AUDIENCE ENTRANCE • TAPING IN PROGRESS in tired violet. A velvet-and-steel queue rope switchbacks toward a turnstile; one lane of it is roped off and dark, the floor beneath scuffed to bare crete. A sponsor loop murmurs from a speaker nobody can find.
name: KSAB Audience Gate
